title: Self-Exploration and Career Development
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Pre-Technical Studies; not yet checked by a Pre-Technical Studies teacher; safety lines marked SAFETY in the library to confirm first; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: A learner's own career choice (outcome d) is a portfolio entry discussed with the teacher, never marked right or wrong. The questions test the knowledge for making the choice.

skills.key_step: The learner explains ways of nurturing talents (practice, coaching, clubs, competitions, mentors), relates talents and abilities to career pathways (STEM, Social Sciences, Arts and Sports Science), analyses ethical and unethical uses of talents, and uses this knowledge to think about a career (the learner's own choice is a portfolio entry, not marked right or wrong).

floor.prerequisite: Knows the qualities of an entrepreneur.
floor.question: Name one quality of an entrepreneur.

steps: Link it to careers and a pathway.
Say what ethical use looks like.
contexts: a learner who loves fixing radios

board.do: Write "talent for drawing" in the middle of a web.

board.say: Name a career that uses this talent.

board.do: Wait for the learner to say design, architecture or art.
Fill in the web and the pathway.

misconceptions.repair: Tell the story of a local footballer or musician: years of practice and coaching. Plan one way to practise a talent weekly.

listen_for: Yes, he earns money from his talent
misconceptions.ask: A learner who draws well is paid to do classmates' art homework. Is this an ethical use of the talent?
misconceptions.repair: Sort uses of talents into ethical (fair, honest, helps others) and unethical (cheating, harming, deceiving).

misconceptions.ask: Which career links best to a talent for drawing?
misconceptions.repair: Make a talent and career web: drawing leads to design, architecture, engineering drawing, art.

listen_for: Only singing, because a person has one talent
misconceptions.ask: Achieng sings well and is good at mathematics. What should guide her career choice?
misconceptions.repair: List several talents and abilities for one person; show careers that use more than one (sound engineering uses music and mathematics).

checks.question: Give one unethical use of a talent.
